focus: Model git symlink and gitignore interactions for specs relocation
noveltyJustification: Six fully new git/gitignore findings covering SOURCE negation, global ignores, and inversion hazards.
keyQuestions: What happens to the root specs symlink, repo .gitignore !specs/!.opencode/ negations, and ~/.gitignore_global /specs + /.opencode/ rules if the real tree moves to top-level specs/?
answeredQuestions: specs is tracked symlink 120000; SOURCE uses !specs/!.opencode/; global ignores /specs and /.opencode/; inversion requires mass path reindex in SOURCE and changes meaning of global /specs for downstream.
ruledOut: Symlink flip alone enough for gitignore
/.opencode/ ignore becomes irrelevant after specs move
